summary: The PR cleanly adds `link_rel` support to `HTMLRenderer`, applying the `rel` attribute to all `<a>` elements (normal links, autolinks, and url plugin links) while leaving images unaffected and preserving default behavior. All tests, ruff linter checks, and mypy type checks pass successfully.
checked: uv run python -c 'import mistune; renderer = mistune.HTMLRenderer(link_rel="nofollow ugc"); md = mistune.create_markdown(renderer=renderer, plugins=["url"]); print(md("[site](https://example.com)")); print(md("https://example.com"))'
